title: I2I Backdoor: Backdoor Attacks against Image-to-Image Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2407.10445v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning technology, deep learning-based Image-to-Image (I2I) networks have become the predominant choice for I2I tasks like image super-resolution and denoising. Despite their remarkable performance, the security of I2I networks has not been thoroughly investigated. While some studies have probed their susceptibility to adversarial attacks, none have explored the backdoor attack against I2I networks, which is a more stealthy and severe threat. In this work, for the first time, we comprehensively investigate the vulnerability of I2I networks to backdoor attacks. We propose a backdoor attack against I2I tasks, where the backdoored I2I network behaves normally on clean input images, yet outputs a specific inappropriate image when the backdoor trigger appears on the input image. translated_title: I2I后门：针对图像到图像任务的后门攻击
translated_abstract: 随着深度学习技术的快速发展，基于深度学习的图像到图像（I2I）网络已成为图像超分辨率和去噪等I2I任务的主流选择。尽管其性能卓越，但I2I网络的安全性尚未得到充分研究。虽然一些研究已经探讨了它们对对抗攻击的易感性，但尚无研究探索针对I2I网络的后门攻击，而后门攻击是一种更隐蔽、更严重的威胁。在这项工作中，我们首次全面研究了I2I网络对后门攻击的脆弱性。我们提出了一种针对I2I任务的后门攻击方法，其中带有后门的I2I网络在干净输入图像上表现正常，但当后门触发器出现在输入图像上时，会输出特定的不当图像。为实现这种I2I后门攻击，我们设计了一种用于I2I的通用对抗扰动（UAP）生成算法。
tldr: 该论文首次全面研究了图像到图像（I2I）网络对后门攻击的脆弱性，提出了一种利用通用对抗扰动作为触发器的后门攻击方法，使带有后门的I2I网络在正常输入下表现正常、而在触发器出现时输出特定不当图像。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive investigation of the vulnerability of Image-to-Image (I2I) networks to backdoor attacks, proposing a backdoor attack method that uses universal adversarial perturbations as triggers, causing the backdoored I2I network to behave normally on clean inputs but output specific inappropriate images when the trigger appears.
